lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: Part 21 of a comedy mini-series about Tolyan building his own car dealership: a race to call a seller first, a car blogger's live stream, the deadline met at 23:58. Brisk, ironic narration with comic timing. Last line: a confident, warm advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват».

tolyan.profile: Tolyan — a cocky Russian used-car flipper (perekup) in his 30s, street swagger, deep raspy voice, show-off, calls everyone «брат». Adult street comedy.
tolyan.notes: No swearing. Line 1: calm, cool, a little proud, on camera. Line 2: friendly mocking advice to a rival.

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: No swearing. Line 1: furious, shouting at a busy phone line. Line 2: out of breath, indignant. Line 3: quiet, slow, menacing, at night.

kirill.profile: Kirill — a young, hyper-energetic Russian car blogger in his mid-20s, streams everything, loud and enthusiastic like a YouTuber talking to his audience. Adult street comedy.
kirill.notes: No swearing. Line 1: cheerful on the phone. Line 2: hyped, addressing stream viewers. Line 3: amazed. Line 4: delighted, recognizing a meme star.

rimma.profile: Rimma Zakharovna — a strict, businesslike Russian woman in her 50s who owns a former gas station lot; cool, precise, a little ironic, always calls Tolyan by his full name «Анатолий».
rimma.notes: One line: dry, strict, but with a hint of respect — the deal is done.
